--- Full Notice Text --- LEGAL ADVERTISEMENT OSCEOLA COUNTY BOARD OF COUNTY COMMISSIONERS PROJECTS: 1) AR-27-16179-AS, Metro-Ethernet and Dedicated Internet Access for Osceola County Libraries eRate Subsidized.The Solicitation document and any addenda can be accessed and downloaded from Vendorlink at the following web address: Vendorlink.osceola.org. There will be no pre-proposal conference for this project. The deadline for questions is Thursday, November 19, 2026, at 12:00 p.m. local time. Due Date is Tuesday, December 15, 2026, at 2:00 p.m. local time. Contact: Arima Santana (407) 742-0925. 2)ITB-27-15110-PC - Osceola County Board of County Commissioners is seeking bids from Florida Department of Transportation (FDOT) pre-qualified contractors to provide Construction Services for Intersection Improvements with Traffic Signals at Funie Steed Road & Lindfields Boulevard and Funie Steed Road & Formosa Gardens Boulevard (FM # 451545-1-58-01). This project involves the construction of a Traffic Signal at Funie Steed Rd and Lindfields Blvd & Funie Steed Rd and Formosa Gardens Blvd, milling and resurfacing, overbuild, widening with adding turn lanes, adding curb & gutter including ADA ramps and drainage improvements. Additionally upgrading signing & pavement marking and providing intersection lighting. To be considered, the Contractor (Prime) shall be Florida Department of Transportation (FDOT) Prequalified in the following Work Classes: 7. Drainage, 10. Flexible Paving, and 11. Grading. The solicitation document and any addenda can be accessed and downloaded from VendorLink at the following web address: https://Vendorlink.osceola.org. There will be a VIRTUAL NON-MANDATORY PRE-BID CONFERENCE on Tuesday, November 17, 2026 at 10:00 AM Local Time. Dial in at 407-906-2344, and when prompted, enter the following conference code: 815 277 835#. Please note the meeting will be audio recorded.The deadline for questions is Wednesday, December 2, 2026, at 12:00 PM Local Time. DUE DATE: Tuesday, December 15, 2026, at 12:00 PM Local Time. Contact: Paul Callaway (407) 742-0932. The broadcast date is November 8, 2026. FOR MORE INFORMATION, VISIT OSCEOLA COUNTYS VENDORLINK WEB SITE AT http://vendorlink.osceola.org. November 12, 2026
